reviews.text: This ampoule became one of my favorite calming skincare products for my oily to combination skin. The texture is very lightweight, watery, and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It helped calm down redness and irritation while keeping my skin hydrated and balanced. I also noticed my skin felt smoother and healthier after regular use. It works really well with other skincare products and never felt heavy or greasy on my face. Perfect for sensitive, oily, or acne-prone skin that needs soothing and hydration.
reviews.zh: 呢支安瓶成為我油性至混合性皮膚最鍾意嘅鎮靜護膚品之一。質地非常輕薄、水感，吸收得快，唔會留有黏笠感。佢幫助鎮靜泛紅同刺激，同時保持皮膚水分同平衡。持續用之後我亦留意到皮膚感覺更滑更健康。佢同其他護膚品夾得好用，喺塊面上面從來唔會有厚重或油膩感。敏感肌、油性肌或容易爆瘡嘅膚質，需要舒緩同保濕嘅人必備。

reviews.text:
Review: A literal lifesaver for my Rosacea!
​The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Ampoule is my ultimate holy grail. Dealing with Rosacea can be incredibly frustrating, but this product has been a total lifesaver for my skin. It’s made of 100% Centella Asiatica extract, and you can really feel the quality.
​It calms down my redness almost instantly and provides a cooling, soothing sensation that my sensitive face craves. The texture is watery and lightweight, absorbing deep into the skin without any irritation. It has significantly strengthened my skin barrier and reduced flare-ups. If you struggle with redness or sensitivity, you need this in your life. I’ll never be without it!
reviews.zh:
評價：救我酒渣肌嘅大恩人！
SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Ampoule 係我嘅終極必買。處理酒渣肌真係令人非常沮喪，但呢件產品對我塊面嚟講係十足嘅救星。佢由 100% 積雪草萃取製成，質素真係感受到。
佢幾乎即刻鎮靜我嘅泛紅，提供我呢張敏感肌渴望嘅清涼舒緩感覺。質地水感輕薄，深入皮膚吸收之餘又唔會刺激。佢顯著咁強化咗我嘅皮膚屏障，仲減少咗發作。如果你受泛紅或敏感困擾，你人生一定要有佢。我以後都唔會冇佢！

reviews.text: I have very irritable skin, but thankfully this did not cause any redness or allergic reactions. That being said, I have not noticed much of a difference in my skin after using this. I think there are better products on the market.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚非常容易過敏，但好彩呢款冇引起泛紅或過敏反應。雖然係咁講，用完之後我冇留意到皮膚有咩大變化。我覺得市面上有更好嘅產品。

reviews.text:
A signature ampoule offers hydrating, redness and irritation relief (anti-inflammatory), barrier strengthening, soothing and antioxidant properties. 

Product Benefits:
Calming, Hydrating, Acne Care

Skin Type:
Sensitive, Acne, Normal

Texture:
Watery and slippery ampoule smoothly spreads and quickly penetrates the skin to keep it hydrated without stickiness.

Key Ingredients:
Centella Asiatica Extract
Contains active ingredients such as madecassic acid and asiaticoside, which aid in collagen synthesis, promoting excellent wound healing and skin regeneration. It also has soothing properties that help in trouble care. Additionally, it protects the skin from free radicals and revitalizes tired skin.
reviews.zh:
招牌安瓶提供保濕、舒緩泛紅同刺激（抗炎）、強化屏障、舒緩及抗氧化功效。

產品功效：
鎮靜、保濕、痘痘護理

適用膚質：
敏感肌、痘痘肌、正常肌

質地：
水感滑溜嘅安瓶容易推開，快速滲透皮膚，保持保濕之餘唔會黏笠。

主要成分：
積雪草萃取
含有羥基積雪草酸同積雪草苷等活性成分，有助膠原蛋白合成，促進極佳嘅傷口癒合同皮膚再生。佢亦具有舒緩特性，有助問題肌護理。此外，佢保護皮膚免受自由基傷害，仲能激活疲憊嘅皮膚。

reviews.text:
I used tretinoin - BIG mistake. My skin turned very sensitive and dry, and when I put skincare on, it would burn and make it look darker. I then bought this product along with others. Here is my review on all of them. I hope this helps!~♡

~ 1: Super gentle and non-irritating!10/10!!

~ 2: Couldn’t rub on my skin since I can’t exfoliate, but as a face mask, it cooled and calmed down my skin, decreased breakouts and lightened my hyperpigmentation.10/10!!

~ 3: If you don't want exfoliation, then this isn't for you. Pretty hydrating, but heavy. Switching to Torriden DIVE IN serum.8/10!!

~ 4: I didn't use it for enough time to do a proper review since it broke, though, it was very lightweight and calmed down my skin.The Mixsoon Centella Essence was heavier, which i didn't like.10/10!!

~ 5: At the start, it would make my skin irritated, but I then found it very lightweight, hydrating and cooling.10/10!!

Overall, my skin became less sensitive and smoother thanks to these products :)
reviews.zh:
我曾經用 A 酸——大錯特錯。我塊面變得非常敏感又乾燥，搽護膚品嘅時候會拮住，仲會令膚色變深。之後我買咗呢件產品同其他產品一齊用。以下係我對佢哋嘅評價，希望幫到手！~♡

~ 1：超級溫和唔刺激！10/10！！

~ 2：因為我唔可以磨砂，所以唔可以喺皮膚上磨，但用嚟做面膜就涼涼地鎮靜咗我嘅皮膚，減少咗爆瘡，仲減淡咗我嘅色素沉澱。10/10！！

~ 3：如果你唔想要去角質效果，咁呢款就唔啱你。保濕度幾好，但比較厚重。轉咗用 Torriden DIVE IN 精華。8/10！！

~ 4：用嘅時間唔夠長，未能寫出完整評價，因為佢爛咗，但用嘅時候感覺非常輕薄，仲鎮靜咗我嘅皮膚。Mixsoon Centella Essence 比較厚重，我唔太鍾意。10/10！！

~ 5：開頭用嘅時候會令我皮膚有刺激感，但後來我發現佢非常輕薄、保濕又涼爽。10/10！！

總括嚟講，多謝呢啲產品，我嘅皮膚冇咁敏感又滑咗 :)

reviews.text:
The lightweight texture of the ampoule allows it to absorb quickly into the skin, leaving behind a veil of hydration that feels nourishing and comforting. I love how it instantly soothes any redness or irritation, leaving my complexion looking calm and balanced. Whether used as a standalone treatment or layered with other skincare products, this ampoule seamlessly integrates into my routine, providing a boost of hydration and radiance that lasts throughout the day.

What sets SKIN1004 apart is its commitment to clean and natural ingredients. Free from harmful additives and artificial fragrances, this ampoule is suitable for even the most sensitive skin types, ensuring a gentle yet effective approach to skincare.
reviews.zh:
安瓶嘅輕薄質地令佢快速滲透皮膚，留下一層滋養舒適嘅保濕膜。我鍾意佢即時舒緩泛紅或刺激嘅效果，令我膚色睇落平靜又平衡。無論單獨使用定係疊加其他護膚品，呢支安瓶都能完美融入我嘅護膚程序，提供全日持久嘅保濕亮澤。

SKIN1004 與眾不同之處在於佢對純淨同天然成分嘅堅持。冇有害添加劑同人工香料，呢支安瓶連最敏感嘅膚質都適合使用，確保以溫和但有效嘅方式護膚。

reviews.text:
I bought this ampoule to be used in combo with my vitamin c serum (goodal). This ampoule is super light-weight and feels like water. I have to be careful when I applying it to my skin because it will quickly run down my face. So far I'm enjoying it. It feels really nice and I have not felt any skin irritations. 

Even though this ampoule is lighter then the vitamin c serum, I do use the serum first because vitamin c is unstable. It does feel like using the ampoule after helps lock in the vitamin c serum.
reviews.zh:
我買呢支安瓶係用嚟同我支維他命 C 精華（goodal）一齊用。呢支安瓶超級輕薄，似水一樣。搽上皮膚嘅時候要小心，因為佢會好快流落塊面。到目前為止用得好享受。感覺真係好好，亦冇感到任何刺激。

雖然呢支安瓶比起維他命 C 精華更輕薄，但我會先用精華，因為維他命 C 唔穩定。用完之後再用安瓶，感覺真係有助鎖住維他命 C 精華。

reviews.text:
this product is amazing. i have very dry, sensitive skin, so i try not to experiment too much with new skincare products. however, i wanted to try this product because it was really popular and had a lot of good reviews. 

the ingredient list is incredible. there’s only one ingredient, centra extract, so it’s a low irritant and non pore clogging product. when i apply the ampoule, it feels watery, absorbing quickly into my skin. it’s also very moisturizing, leaving my skin feeling moisturized, dewey, and glowy. 

i had a small whitehead on the side of my checks for several weeks, but after applying this once, the whitehead immediately disappeared. 

this ampoule is really calming and hydrating, and i recommend everyone to try it (especially if you have sensitive skin)!
reviews.zh:
呢件產品好正。我皮膚非常乾燥又敏感，所以盡量唔會亂試新嘅護膚品。但係我想試呢件產品，因為佢真係好流行，好多好評。

成分表勁正。只有一個成分，centra 萃取，所以係低刺激、唔會堵塞毛孔嘅產品。搽上安瓶嘅時候感覺水水的，快速滲透皮膚入面。佢仲非常保濕，畀到我皮膚保濕、水潤同有光澤嘅感覺。

我面頰側邊有一粒細細嘅白頭，生咗幾個星期，但用咗一次之後，白頭即刻消失晒。

呢支安瓶真係好鎮靜又保濕，我推薦所有人試吓（尤其如果你有敏感肌）！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
